Authors call it the peak/maximum; equals the merged measured point, so measured. Abstract (main p.1) prints the same maximum as '15.29 mol/kg at cryogenic temperature at 46.21 bar'; it conflicts with Section 3.4 and the conclusions (15.59 mol/kg at 46.71 bar), and the digitized marker (15.594 mol/kg) supports 15.59, so the abstract figure is treated as a misprint of this measurement and not given its own row. Temperature printed 'liquid nitrogen temperature (LN2; -196 °C)' in Section 3.4 and '-196.0 °C' in the abstract; stored 77.15 K (number printed, so not inferred). Isotherm Fig. 8 bottom has 7 markers: a clipped marker at the axis origin (not separable by the tool, not extracted) and 6 markers with error bars and drop lines; error bars are shown but no numerical uncertainty is printed, so uncertainty_wt_pct is empty and replicates_reported is true. Markers are half-filled circles: the tool centroid sits about 1.6-2.5 px (0.1-0.17 bar) left of the paper's drop lines. material_class other: unactivated pyrolysis biochar; paper reports no visible XRD mineral peaks for the 900 °C biochar (peaks seen at 700/800 °C 'significantly decreased' at elevated temperature). Uptake printed in mol/kg (= mmol/g); uptake_wt_pct is W1 computed (0.201588 x mmol/g). Basis not named ('H2 adsorption capacity'); automated Sievert's PCT Pro (volumetric) so basis_inferred excess by instrumental default. PCT Pro model named without manufacturer, so instrument_identified false. Free volume: He (at 4-5 bar) used to calibrate instrument volume before runs; temperature not stated. Degassing: sample oven-dried 80 °C 12 h, degassed under vacuum 12 h on VacPrep 061 (Micromeritics; temperature not stated), then degassed 30 min at 30 °C in the sample holder before each adsorption test; degas fields hold the last step (printed '30 min', stored 0.5 h). Sample mass 0.25-0.50 g per run (range, not stored). H2 99.999 mol%. Surface area, total pore volume and average pore width from Table 2: BET with Ar at -185.86 °C (Tristar II 320); BET relative-pressure range not stated; pore-volume and pore-width methods not stated. Pyrolysis pressure of the biochar used for H2 tests not stated (pyrolysis runs at 1.01-30 bar); Table 2 and Fig. 8 both label samples by pyrolysis temperature only, so area_same_sample coded yes.
